coupling: The faster weekday lookup uses 7 as the unrecognized-day sentinel and bounds the full-name lookup to indices below 7, preserving the public -1 result for unknown names. The later suffix-table change accepts any nonnegative lookup result before indexing its seven-entry table. Each edit is safe with the original companion commit: the first guards index 7, and the second sees only -1 or 0..6. Together an unknown alphabetic weekday reaches index 7 in daysuffix, so review and repair require following the sentinel contract across both commits.
